units.radiance: original little-endian captured FP16 RGBA; input alpha contains hit distance; no gain, normalization, clipping, conversion or exposure
units.normal_roughness: original packed RGB10A2 uint32; oct normal bits0..19, linear roughness bits20..29, material bits30..31; world-space normals
units.controls: original 46 uint32 words; preserve bits and original provider frame index
units.camera_arrays: original capture uint32 IEEE-754 word encodings; .view('<f4') for numeric camera matrices/positions

coordinates.pixel_convention: local integer pixel centers; the +0.5 terms cancel in correspondence
coordinates.motion_rg: original physical full-render UV; previous minus current; no crop scaling or extra jitter applied
coordinates.previous_local_formula: q_previous_local = current_local + crop_origin_render[t] + input_motion[t, ..., :2] * render_extent - crop_origin_render[t-1]
coordinates.valid_bilinear: finite q and 0 <= qx < width-1 and 0 <= qy < height-1; outside crop is INVALID, never clamp or wrap
coordinates.first_frame: No previous fixture frame; do not loop the last frame to the first
